svg.title: SD04b — F08 proposal, confirmation, Observer and contingency

g.text: SD04b — F08 proposal, confirmation, Observer and contingency
Validate isolated snapshot; store pending PlanChange with before fields
SD07 save pending proposal; real event facts unchanged
CLI natural alternative: proposeChange -> adaptive.propose -> interpret.
GUI preview obtains fields from SD04a.
Remove pending proposal; leave real event unchanged
Validate candidate snapshot; assign facts; reset communication approvals
SD07 save meaningful resulting state; save failure restores before
No weather tool, forecast call, supplier check or automatic contingency application.
GUI cancel-dialog alone makes no call; proposal remains pending.
CLI negative confirmation calls false and removes pending proposal.
